description: This file defines the EmailQueueDao class, which handles database operations related to email queue management in the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to retrieve, save, and delete email records, as well as fetch IDs of pending emails.

classes.name: EmailQueueDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for Email Queue, extending BaseDao to perform email-related database operations.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Retrieve a Mail entity by its ID.

methods.name: saveEmail
methods.description: Persist a Mail entity to the database.

methods.name: removeFromQueue
methods.description: Remove multiple Mail entities from the queue based on their IDs.

methods.name: getAllPendingMailIds
methods.description: Fetch IDs of all emails with status pending.
